ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT ANDDEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT(this"Agreement"), made asof the27dayofJuLy ,2015,by and between by and between Silvershore Properties 72, LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at 441 Lexington Avenue, New York, NY 10017 (hereinafter referred to as “Owner") and 475 Keap Street, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 512 Seventh Avenue, 15th Floor, New York,NewYork 10018 (hereinafter referred to as"Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner represents that it is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lot 16 in Block 2371 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings, and known as and by the street addresses of 488 Metropolitan Avenue, and more particularly described in Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Owner Land": the building located thereon is herein referred to as the "Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the "Owner Premises'); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain lands, with the buildings and improvements thereon, if any, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of NewYork,known as Lot 21 in Block 2371 on the TaxMap of the City of NewYork,County of Kings, and known as and by the street address of 500 Metropolitan Avenue and more particularly described on Exhibit "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Developer Land"; the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the "Existing Developer Building'"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the Existing Developer Building, if any, and construct a new building, all or a portion of which will be on the Developer Land, and to construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Existing Developer Building or the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution, than is now available for use on the Owner Premises pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the “Excess Zoning Rights" (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to theDeveloperPremises and anyAdditionalParcel (ashereinafter defined);
